=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md (and workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md): lines 9-16 (Step 0) and line 15 (Step 1) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup trigger for the issue-mode path is placed under Step 0 (Session preflight), but the instructions require the Source issue: identifier, which is only resolved at Step 1 (Plan resolution).
  WHY: An unattended session running the step-by-step instructions will attempt the cleanup in Step 0 before Step 1 has read the plan to resolve the issue identifier; without the identifier, the label check cannot be performed, and the stopped stage session is not archived, re-introducing the bug this PR aims to fix.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md (and workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md): line 108 (Issue-mode stop rename instruction) and line 191 (Cleanup label read predicate) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The issue-mode stop sequence does not define failure-handling paths for set_session_title rename failures or transient mcp__github__issue_read label-read failures.
  WHY: A rename failure leaves the session with its old title (which cleanup won't match), and a label-read failure can skip archival without reporting, requiring manual operator intervention.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The lint check (tests/inventory_parity.py) must pass for the PR to merge; scripts/claude_pr_sweep.py must be documented in the docs/INVENTORY.md Scripts section (or explicitly exempted).
  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md Scripts section (or tests/inventory_exemptions.txt)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff does not touch docs/INVENTORY.md to include scripts/claude_pr_sweep.py; tests/inventory_parity.py fails on this PR head, blocking the merge.
- requirement: A contract test must pin the issue-mode cleanup trigger's placement after Step 1 reads the plan and verify the cleanup header distinguishes issue-mode timing, so a future edit cannot silently regress the trigger.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py — extend test_issue_mode_archives_stopped_stage_sessions (or add a sibling test).
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: Existing tests only check text-string existence ("implement-plan <slug> — <stage> — blocked on issue", "Issue-mode resume without a — resume. block", "Issue mode: stopped stage sessions.", "no longer carries ai:claude-blocked", etc.). They do not assert that Step 1 invokes cleanup, do not assert that the cleanup-section header distinguishes issue-mode timing from the strict step-0 invariant, and do not pin the deferred trigger's placement outside the strict step-0-cleanup invariant.
- requirement: The cleanup-section header at line 187 must be revised to recognize the issue-mode timing exception, so an unattended session reading the header understands that issue-mode cleanup runs after Step 1, not in Step 0.
  expected_change_site: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md line 187 (and workflow-templates twin)
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The cleanup-section header still reads "Every stage session runs this in step 0, after resume hygiene, so stray checkers never pile up", without an exception for issue-mode timing. This contradicts the deferred issue-mode timing instruction in the Step 0 bullet.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
